space.claim: 2-degree lattice of centroid-associated CPC cells, not a national census and not 3143 counties

time.cf_time: hours since 1900-01-01 00:00:00, gregorian, daily sum labeled by that calendar date
time.old_artifact_test_overlap: 2025 overlaps the stored district test window 2025-01-01/2026-08-27; this is not an untouched external test

bootstrap.method: circular moving blocks, concatenated and trimmed to the full test length
bootstrap.replicate_increase: 400 instead of 200 for percentile stability; block length unchanged; not used to choose a model

supplement_2026.note: Short partial year. Not a substitute for the 2025 test and not a selected window.

run_id_note: sha256 prefix of protocol id, selected precip float32 bytes, and the qimen feature file. Assigned from those hashes after the fit. Not used to choose a model.
deprecated_reason: The first scored F1/precision macro dropped a cell when precision was undefined (no predicted wet day). That removed hard all-dry forecasts from the F1 average. Brier, log loss and ROC-AUC did not use that rule. Replaced metrics use 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN) on the same probabilities.

exclusion.arithmetic: 8928 bbox; 2786 within 60 km; 272 block representatives; minus invalid days; minus 2023 single-class. The two drop reasons are sequential, not an extra overlapping five.
exclusion.mask_wording: 60 km neighborhood of the project's administrative centroids, then one cell per 2 degree block. Not a sovereign land mask and not a national census.
exclusion.note: The five removed representatives are missing on all 1096 days. They are not a second set of one-class cells. Among the 267 complete cells, the 2023 single-class count is 0.

feature_check.source: extractScoreFeatures sliced at 31, before pillar columns that start with 年支合地盘
feature_check.same_day_noon_chart: date classification against the CPC calendar label, not a deployable forecast with lead time

protocol_status: local protocol frozen in this repository before the test scores; not a public preregistration
